client.note: All three rendered clients install and activate the exact approved ten-module Friend Edition loadout. RBM is retired after its native campaign-initialization crash. The optional TaleWorlds BirthAndDeath module stays disabled. Birth/Death is accepted only when preflight and the authenticated host runtime authority both prove the resolved CoopData difficulty.birthAndDeath=true value/fingerprint; the packaged seed default is not live evidence.

server.canonicalHarmonyPolicy: Activate the pinned Bannerlord.Harmony v2.4.2.248 Workshop module before Native and Coop. Its Win64 0Harmony and wrapper hashes are proven by the selected nightly's live dedicated-server topology. Coop's embedded 0Harmony is excluded, and no bootstrap is provided or implied.
server.note: Production launch must exactly match the approved ten-module Friend Edition order on both roles. RBM is retired after its native campaign-initialization crash. TaleWorlds BirthAndDeath stays disabled. Preflight and runtime authority must prove the resolved CoopData difficulty.birthAndDeath=true value/fingerprint; the packaged default alone is insufficient.
